data.title: Binance Has Delisted All FTX Leveraged Tokens and Will Complete Distribution of BUSD
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance has now delisted all FTX leveraged tokens including BULL, BEAR, ETHBULL, ETHBEAR, EOSBULL, EOSBEAR, BNBBULL, BNBBEAR, XRPBULL and XRPBEAR, as well as the corresponding trading pairs.

Users that continued to hold FTX tokens after the delisting time of 2020/03/31 10:00 AM (UTC) will be credited with an equivalent value of BUSD to their accounts within 24 hours, based on the number of leveraged tokens held at the time of delisting (the time that trading stopped). The price of each token at 2020/03/31 10:00 AM (UTC) used to swap for BUSD is as follows:

1 BULL = 1370.28 BUSD

1 BEAR = 11.16 BUSD

1 ETHBULL = 79.18 BUSD

1 ETHBEAR = 12.20 BUSD

1 EOSBULL = 3.85 BUSD

1 EOSBEAR = 30.21 BUSD

1 BNBBULL = 57.21 BUSD

1 BNBBEAR = 58.61 BUSD

1 XRPBULL = 8.74 BUSD

1 XRPBEAR = 548.55 BUSD

For further information, please refer to the original delisting announcement: Binance Will Delist All FTX Leveraged Tokens

Risk warning: Cryptocurrency trading is subject to high market risk. Please make your trades cautiously. Binance will make best efforts to choose high quality coins, but will not be responsible for your trading losses.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2020/03/31
